required_behavior: A cross-profile worker child that explicitly requests workspace_kind=worktree inherits its worker task's canonical Project, receives a distinct project worktree and branch, and rejects a conflicting explicit Project.

evidence.finding: The integrated ancestor commit provides cross-profile routing from a canonical source task when a Project has already been inherited.
The target inherits a worker Project only when workspace_kind is omitted, so an explicit worktree request bypasses inheritance and conflict rejection.
The open PR changes inheritance to depend only on an omitted workspace path and rejects a conflicting explicit Project.

retirement_gate.summary: With an empty worker Projects registry, verify a cross-profile explicit worktree child preserves the canonical Project, gets a real distinct worktree and branch, and rejects a conflicting Project.

evidence.result: The omitted-workspace control inherited the Project and received a fresh workspace, but an explicit worktree child did not inherit or get a fresh project workspace and a conflicting Project was not rejected.

evidence.command: public-source inspection of the linked commit and PR
evidence.result: Commit b9b5481d6236edb3ec8aae32cc4b5c661569b872 covers source-task routing; open PR 89363 contains the still-missing explicit-worktree inheritance and conflict check.

artifact_verification.blocker: This ledger entry references no versioned patches/hermes artifact; live runtime files were intentionally not inspected.

blocking_uncertainty: The exact target is only partially equivalent: it retains omitted-workspace cross-profile routing but lacks the explicit-worktree and conflict behavior required for retirement; the completing upstream PR remains open.
summary: Retain HLP-226. The target contains the integrated routing foundation but fails the explicit-worktree and conflicting-Project portions of the recorded behavioral gate.
